description:
Reentrancy in AbstractL1BTCDepositor.finalizeDeposit(uint256) (contracts/cross-chain/AbstractL1BTCDepositor.sol#388-530):
	External calls:
	- (initialDepositAmount,tbtcAmount,destinationChainDepositOwner) = _finalizeDeposit(depositKey) (contracts/cross-chain/AbstractL1BTCDepositor.sol#398-404)
		- (finalizedAt) = tbtcVault.optimisticMintingRequests(depositKey) (contracts/integrator/AbstractBTCDepositor.sol#192-194)
	- reimbursementPool.refund((gasStart - gasleft()()) + msgValueOffset + finalizeDepositGasOffset,msg.sender) (contracts/cross-chain/AbstractL1BTCDepositor.sol#487-492)
	- (success) = address(reimbursementPool).call{gas: 2_000_000}(abi.encodeWithSelector(reimbursementPool.refund.selector,reimbursement.gasSpent,reimbursement.receiver)) (contracts/cross-chain/AbstractL1BTCDepositor.sol#509-517)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- gasReimbursements[depositKey] = reimbursement (contracts/cross-chain/AbstractL1BTCDepositor.sol#521)

review.rationale: The deposit is finalized and the deferred entry cleared before interactions. Restoration and the failure event occur only after a reverted reimbursement call; nested changes from that call have rolled back. See docs/slither-triage.md.
